page_title: ACM 1-0 VER | AC Milan v Verona 15/02/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's all for today as the game is over.

90+4' Antoine Bernede (Verona) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Francesco Fourneau with no other option than to blow for a foul.
90+1' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes it short.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Christian Pulisic (AC Milan) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) sends a cross into the box, but Mike Maignan comes off his line to gather the ball.
89' Francesco Fourneau has a clear sight and sees a foul from Daniel Oyegoke (Verona).
88' Sergio Conceicao has decided to make a change. Filippo Terracciano (AC Milan) replaces Joao Felix.
87' Nicolas Valentini (Verona) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Francesco Fourneau has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
85' It is time for a substitution. Antoine Bernede (Verona) is on for Cheikh Niasse.
84' Domagoj Bradaric goes off the pitch and Daniel Oyegoke (Verona) comes on.
84' Paolo Zanetti prepares a substitution. Tomas Suslov is replaced by Alphadjo Cisse (Verona).
82' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Santiago Tomas Gimenez trots off the pitch and is replaced by Tammy Abraham (AC Milan).
80' It seemed like Tomas Suslov (Verona) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
79' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) has tested the patience of referee Francesco Fourneau and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
75' 1 - 0 Goal! Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) makes the score 1:0 after burying a close-range header in the middle of the goal after a good run and cross by Rafael Leao.
73' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) decides to speed play up by quickly sending the free kick into the box.
73' Tomas Suslov (Verona) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Francesco Fourneau signals. It's a free kick to AC Milan, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
71' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) receives a decent pass from Rafael Leao and immediately goes for goal from mid-range. It's a fine strike but the ball goes just over the bar.
68' Sergio Conceicao has decided to substitute Youssouf Fofana and he is replaced by Christian Pulisic (AC Milan).
68' We are about to witness a subsitution. Daniel Mosquera (Verona) for Amin Sarr.
67' The corner by Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) lacks accuracy as it's hit with too much power.

67' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan have been awarded a corner kick.
67' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) collects a pass on the edge of the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for AC Milan.
66' Joao Felix (AC Milan) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
65' Joao Felix (AC Milan) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
62' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Darko Lazovic (Verona) replaces Grigoris Kastanos.
61' AC Milan take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
60' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
59' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

59' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. AC Milan win a corner kick.
59' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
58' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
57' Rafael Leao (AC Milan) serves up a nice cross, but Lorenzo Montipo punches the ball away.
56' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) is furious with himself for spurning a big chance. He's quickest to the rebound near the penalty spot and produces a header which goes a whisker wide of the right post!
55' The corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona) is intercepted by the defence.
55' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

54' Grigoris Kastanos (Verona) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Verona are awarded a corner kick.
52' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) sends a quick through ball into space for his teammate who is lurking close to the offside line, but one of the defenders intercepts and clears the danger.
50' Ondrej Duda (Verona) picks up a yellow card.
50' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
49' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lorenzo Montipo, who smothers the ball.
49' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders.
49' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
48' Alejandro Jimenez (AC Milan) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. AC Milan force their opponents to concede a corner.
46' The game is over for Riccardo Sottil (AC Milan). Rafael Leao comes on for the second half.
46' Sergio Conceicao makes a half-time substitution. Alejandro Jimenez comes on in place of Kyle Walker (AC Milan).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) finds space inside the box to shoot after collecting a short pass, but it's a wasted effort as it flies high over the bar.
45+1' Ondrej Duda (Verona) sends a cross into the box from the free kick, but his effort lacks accuracy and goes well out of play. The ball goes out of play and AC Milan will have a goal kick.
45+1' The referee blows his whistle after Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) does a good impression of a basketball player and handles the ball. Verona have a free kick.
45' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is able to continue to play.
44' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
43' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
43' Domagoj Bradaric (Verona) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
43' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates.
42' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
41' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
40' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Verona.
40' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
39' The ball possession is 74:26.
37' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle as Yunus Musah (AC Milan) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
35' The referee awards a corner and Riccardo Sottil (AC Milan) goes over to take it.
34' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Kyle Walker (AC Milan), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball goes out of play. AC Milan are awarded a corner kick.
33' A goal, which was scored by Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan), was disallowed due to offside.
31' Tomas Suslov (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for an infringement.
28' Lorenzo Montipo leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Theo Hernandez (AC Milan).
27' Joao Felix (AC Milan) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Lorenzo Montipo intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to AC Milan.
26' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner, but he overhits it and none of his teammates are able to reach the ball.

25' Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) produces a ferocious strike from the edge of the box. His dangerous effort towards the bottom right corner is blocked by Lorenzo Montipo, who pulls off a superb save to keep the ball out of the net. The ball is out of play and AC Milan manage to earn a corner.
24' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
21' Cheikh Niasse (Verona) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Francesco Fourneau had an easy-decision to make.
21' Wonderful movement by AC Milan. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
17' Matteo Gabbia (AC Milan) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle for a foul.
16' Yunus Musah (AC Milan) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
15' Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
12' Joao Felix (AC Milan) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Santiago Tomas Gimenez, but Lorenzo Montipo displays great awareness to stop him.
12' Joao Felix (AC Milan) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Francesco Fourneau who sees an offensive foul.
11' Yellow card. Diego Coppola (Verona) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
10' Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) sprays a pass out to Amin Sarr, but he can't beat his man inside the box.
10' Kyle Walker (AC Milan) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
8' Santiago Tomas Gimenez (AC Milan) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
7' The corner from Theo Hernandez (AC Milan) is cleared away by the defence.

6' Kyle Walker (AC Milan) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The ball goes behind for a corner. AC Milan will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
6' Francesco Fourneau blows his whistle. Tomas Suslov (Verona) commits a foul after dangerous play.
5' It seemed like Tijjani Reijnders (AC Milan) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
5' Francesco Fourneau couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Jackson Tchatchoua (Verona) and blew his whistle. AC Milan have been awarded a free kick.
3' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Ondrej Duda (Verona). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.

2' Ondrej Duda (Verona) takes a nice touch on the edge of the box as he meets a pass and produces a shot towards the roof of the net. What an excellent save by the goalkeeper! Corner kick. Verona will have an opportunity.
1' Ondrej Duda (Verona) whips in a cross from the corner, but Mike Maignan is well positioned and punches the ball away.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Verona will kick the game off.
Francesco Fourneau is the one to supervise the game today.
